value: PROTOTYPE - NOT FOR PRODUCTION. Mikan's five strings (Mikan only; crew keep their Style basic as their AI combo). Times in seconds from the press; chain_s = when the next attack may start; the one-slot buffer accepts a press only in [chain_s - buffer_s, chain_s). Timings tuned so the full L-L-L-H cycle (about 2.6 s, 5.8 MV, 50 FZ) runs near the GDD string's rate (3.5 MV / 30 FZ per 1.8 s), slower in follow-through (M1.1 §2).
